Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The bug in the code is that 'ThreadLocal' variables are not cleaned up when no longer used which can lead to memory leak. In the 'incorrectCleanup' method, 'DELEGATE.set(null)' is used to clear the 'ThreadLocal' variable, which is incorrect. The correct way to clean up a 'ThreadLocal' variable is to use 'DELEGATE.remove()'.
Trigger_Explanation: The showBug() method of the ThreadLocalUserSession class sets a UserSession object, then calls the incorrectCleanup() method which sets the DELEGATE ThreadLocal variable to null. This does not remove the map entry, causing the session to be retained instead of being garbage collected, resulting in a memory leak. The testIncorrectCleanup() method in the ThreadLocalUserSessionTest triggers this bug by calling the showBug() method and then checking if the session has been incorrectly cleaned up using the assertNull() method.
